baseline_models.focus_anchor: The restriction in إنما تجزون ما كنتم تعملون binds recompense to the work the addressees had been doing.
baseline_models.mechanism: Recompense answers action with a matching return, while كنتم gives the action a lived duration and تعملون marks it as intended work. The restrictive construction makes the accumulated work, rather than the present excuse, the operative input.

activation_trace.role: Action answered by its recompense supplies the matching relation between the outcome and the work named after إنما.
Occurrence and presence through time make كنتم the duration over which the actionable record accumulated.
Intended action identifies the material that recompense answers, distinguishing enacted work from a late verbal account of it.

changed_reading.before: The addressees are punished for their deeds.
changed_reading.after: The verse describes an exact settlement whose input is the addressees' accumulated intentional practice; an excuse uttered now cannot replace the work that generated the account.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The sequence الذين كفروا لا تعتذروا اليوم places covering, attempted excuse, and the decisive day together.
baseline_models.mechanism: The addressees are first imaged through covering; excuse can seek erasure of fault, and a more material branch imagines traces becoming effaced. The severe event called 'today' closes that operation: speech can no longer cover or rub out the work-trace that recompense reads.

activation_trace.role: Covering supplies the addressees' characteristic operation and the material image that a last excuse tries to repeat.
Excuse as a request to erase blame supplies the attempted remedial act prohibited by لا.
Effaced and broken traces materialize the deeper wish of the excuse: to make the evidentiary marks disappear.
The day as a severe event makes 'today' a threshold at which attempted erasure has expired.

changed_reading.before: Disbelievers are told not to apologize on the Day of Judgment.
changed_reading.after: Those marked by covering attempt one final cover or erasure, but 'today' is precisely when the accumulated trace can no longer be edited.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The exclusive force of إنما and the object ما كنتم تعملون leave only the addressees' own work in the recompense relation.
baseline_models.mechanism: One recompense branch allows something to discharge or stand in for another, and a كون branch supplies surety for another person. The focus restriction activates those possibilities only to deny them: neither an excuse, guarantor, nor proxy can occupy the place reserved for one's own enacted work.

activation_trace.role: Something standing in for another supplies the substitution possibility that the restrictive syntax closes.
Surety and undertaking for another person sharpen the rejected possibility of transferred responsibility.
The addressees' own intended action is the nontransferable object left after substitution is excluded.

changed_reading.before: Each person is generally responsible for personal deeds.
changed_reading.after: The verse stages and refuses substitution: nothing said or supplied now can discharge the account in place of the addressees' own sustained work.

context_deltas.mechanism: The opening movement distinguishes a mistaken act of prohibition from lawful dissolution, then supplies a delimited, prescribed release of oaths. Against that sequence, لا تعتذروا اليوم does not reject every repair or explanation; it rejects an improvised verbal untying after the authorized period for amendment has closed.

activation_trace.role: Excuse as a request to erase fault is the late self-release whose timing is tested by the preceding remedies.
Prohibition supplies the binding act that the opening correction treats as mistaken.
Dissolution of a restriction supplies a legitimate reversal rather than a merely rhetorical excuse.
A bounded obligation makes the release an authorized procedure with defined terms.
The specific release of an oath supplies the packet's clearest model of a binding being properly undone.
The oath branch identifies the binding speech for which a real release, unlike a late excuse, is provided.

structural_cues: 66:1-2 place mistaken prohibition, lawful dissolution, and prescribed oath-release before the focus prohibition explicitly limited by اليوم.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies both a binding mistake and a formally prescribed untying; I infer an authorized pre-'today' remedy window. A live alternative is that the sequence governs oaths specifically and does not imply a general procedural rule.

changed_reading.before: The command means that explanation or repair is categorically worthless.
changed_reading.after: Repair is not rejected as such; what fails is an unauthorized self-exoneration offered at settlement instead of the earlier, enacted untying the context models.

context_deltas.mechanism: The earlier scene moves information from concealment to exposure, recognition by a sign, and selective turning aside. That sequence converts the baseline covering model into an evidentiary one: by the focus day, the hidden matter has already become legible, so an excuse cannot regain control of the narrative.

activation_trace.role: Covering provides the focus operation reversed by the context's disclosure sequence.
The request to erase blame becomes an attempted narrative remedy after the facts are exposed.
Hiding something inwardly supplies the initial concealed state that an excuse would need to preserve.
Emergence and exposure reverse concealment and make the matter available for judgment.
Recognition from a trace or sign makes the exposed matter evidentiary rather than merely rumored.
Turning one's side away supplies the limited human response that cannot undo what has been recognized.

structural_cues: 66:3 orders the states as secret, report, divine exposure, recognition of part, and turning aside from part; this disclosure pattern precedes the focus address.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies concealment, exposure, trace-based recognition, and partial turning away; I infer that these form a miniature evidence process that makes later excuse ineffective. The alternative is that the scene demonstrates divine knowledge without defining the mechanics of 66:7.

changed_reading.before: Excuses are refused simply because the verdict is severe.
changed_reading.after: Excuses are inert because concealed conduct has already crossed into exposed, recognizable evidence; late speech cannot restore the former hidden state.

context_deltas.mechanism: Immediately before the focus, protective action is commanded while the fire has specified fuel and its agents execute commands without deviation. The repeated action clauses then meet ما كنتم تعملون. This makes اليوم a phase boundary: before it, doing can protect; at it, an exact execution process answers what was done, and excuses have no causal role.

activation_trace.role: The severe event called 'today' supplies the temporal switch from prevention to execution.
Action-matched recompense supplies the exact process operating after the switch.
Putting oneself inside protection supplies the available action on the preventive side of the deadline.
Fuel as material input makes the threatened process concrete and already provisioned.
Hard stone adds material resistance to persuasion, reinforcing the non-negotiable execution image.
Departure from obedience is explicitly negated, so the executing agents do not open an exception for an excuse.
Binding command supplies the exact instruction that governs the agents' action.
Producing an act completes the parallel between what the agents execute and what the addressees had worked.

structural_cues: The adjacent wording moves from ما أمرهم and ويفعلون ما يؤمرون in 66:6 to ما كنتم تعملون in 66:7.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies prior protection, concrete fuel, non-disobedient agents, and parallel action clauses; I infer a deadline between preventable conduct and rule-bound execution. A live alternative is that 66:6 and 66:7 are adjacent warnings without a shared procedural timeline.

changed_reading.before: 'Today' is only a date on which apologies are forbidden.
changed_reading.after: 'Today' marks a causal phase change: protective doing belonged before it, while exact execution now answers prior doing, leaving apology procedurally inert.

context_deltas.mechanism: The next ayah activates a second covering with the same ك ف ر root: God may cover or efface evil consequences in connection with an unalloyed return, and forgiveness protects the person from the fault's effect. The focus therefore opposes two coverings. The addressees' covering of truth and late excuse cannot perform the counter-covering associated with prior, enacted return.

activation_trace.role: Obstructing truth supplies the addressees' direction of covering.
The late request to erase blame is contrasted with a contextually enacted route to erasure.
Purity from mixture gives the return its unalloyed quality, distinguishing it from strategic excuse.
Covering a fault until it is as though not done supplies the reversed, beneficial operation of the focus root.
Covering sin while shielding its bearer from its effect supplies the protective result unavailable to a bare excuse.

structural_cues: 66:7 and 66:8 place opposite-valence uses of ك ف ر across consecutive addresses, and 66:8 pairs the beneficial covering with sincere return and a request for forgiveness.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the same root with reversed agent and valence, plus purity and forgiveness; I infer that enacted return changes who covers what before settlement. The live alternative is ordinary polysemy: the two uses may be conventionally distinct without forming a deliberate reversal.

changed_reading.before: The verse condemns people called disbelievers for covering and refuses their apology.
changed_reading.after: The sequence contrasts failed self-covering with a possible divine counter-covering tied to sincere return; a speech-only excuse on 'today' cannot generate that reversal.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later examples contrast two women who were situated with righteous servants yet breached fidelity and received no sufficiency from them, with Mary, whose being among the obedient is accompanied by enacted confirmation. These frames sharpen ما كنتم تعملون: durable identity is tested by enacted alignment, and another person's righteousness cannot discharge the account.

activation_trace.role: Standing in for another supplies the substitution that the examples explicitly frustrate.
Intended action supplies the personal test that remains after borrowed status fails.
Being present in a past relational state supplies status and duration without guaranteeing aligned action.
Deficiency in fidelity supplies the action that defeats the apparent protection of righteous association.
Sufficiency is explicitly denied, showing that the associates cannot answer or discharge the women's account.
Making truth effective in deed supplies enacted confirmation rather than nominal affiliation.
Her being among the obedient supplies the contrasting durable state whose surrounding actions substantiate it.
Submissive religious obedience names the aligned practice that the final state gathers up.

structural_cues: 66:10 says كانتا of women placed with righteous servants, then denies those servants' sufficiency after betrayal; 66:12 says كانت of Mary only after predicates of guarding and confirming.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies contrasting كان states, breach, failed sufficiency, enacted confirmation, and obedience; I infer that action validates or voids relational status. The alternative is that the examples classify belief and unbelief without commenting on the syntax of كنتم تعملون.

changed_reading.before: The focus teaches personal responsibility in the abstract.
changed_reading.after: The focus tests whether claimed or borrowed belonging ever became one's own practice: relational proximity cannot pay, while sustained action reveals the substance of one's being.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it uses the packet's secondary ج ز ي to ج ز ز mapping and links it to the seed-covering branch of ك ف ر. It remains anchored in the focus's coverer, severe day, recompense verb, and intended work. Downstream prose should present it only as a material analogy activated by the split inventory, not as the lexical meaning of تجزون.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: كفروا, اليوم, تجزون, and تعملون can form a seed-to-harvest sequence inside the focus ayah.

activation_trace.role: Covering seed with soil supplies the hidden planting stage of the material analogy.
The severe event called 'today' supplies the decisive season when hidden growth reaches consequence.
The mapped cutting root's time of harvest when produce is ripe supplies the outcome stage.
Intended work supplies what was planted and what now yields a harvest.

changed_reading.before: Recompense is an externally imposed payment for completed acts.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, 'today' is harvest time: concealed intentional work has ripened into the very yield now cut, so apology cannot alter what grew.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates the office or administered-work branch of ع م ل rather than stopping at discrete deeds. It remains anchored in تعملون and is sharpened when 66:11 separates Pharaoh, his work, and the unjust people as objects of rescue. Downstream prose should qualify it as a social-scale possibility; عمله may still mean his conduct rather than an institutional regime.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The sustained كنتم تعملون can admit not only acts but the work-order the addressees repeatedly served.

activation_trace.role: Holding and administering a work enlarges the focus anchor from isolated acts to an operative charge or order.
Building by joining parts supplies the constructive alternative requested against the destructive work-order.
Rescue by separation supplies the mechanism for disentangling a person from a ruler, his work, and his people.
Pharaoh's work activates the administered-work image at social scale as something from which rescue is sought.
Withholding people from their right supplies the operative harm binding the ruler's work to the unjust collective.

changed_reading.before: What you used to do means a sum of individually countable deeds.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, it can include the sustained work-order one staffed and perpetuated; recompense reaches participation in an unjust operation, not only isolated acts.

strongest_changes: The adjacent command/action clauses turn 'today' into a phase boundary between preventive doing and exact, non-negotiable execution.
The next ayah reverses the ك ف ر image: failed human covering is set against a divine counter-covering associated with sincere return, so late excuse cannot substitute for enacted change.
The later كان examples show that relational status neither transfers righteousness nor settles the account; sustained action reveals whether belonging became real.
summary.what_was_special: The focus became a compact mechanics of temporal closure, failed erasure, and non-substitution rather than a generic refusal of apology. The packet also kept two riskier images alive: hidden work ripening to harvest, and work as a social order from which a person may need separation.
remaining_uncertainties: The authorized-remedy reading depends on extending the oath-release sequence into a broader timing principle.
The counter-covering reading may reflect ordinary polysemy rather than an intended root reversal.
The harvest model depends on the non-dominant ج ز ز mapping, and the work-regime model depends on a branch broader than the immediate surface sense.
